title: Amberstill Ranch
wikitext:
[[File:Amberstill Ranch.jpg|thumb|300px|Amberstill Ranch]]

'''Amberstill Ranch''' is a ranch found off the road that leads to [[Loch Modan]], north of [[Gol'Bolar Quarry]] in [[Dun Morogh]]. Players can buy a [[Rabbit Crate (Snowshoe)]] here from [[Yarlyn Amberstill]], as well as accept a [[quest]], {{questlong|Alliance|12+|Protecting the Herd}}, to kill a [[Wendigo]] named [[Vagash]]. This ranch also has a [[Riding trainer]] and [[mount]] [[vendor]], from whom [[Dwarf|dwarves]] (or players of any other [[Alliance]] race who have obtained exalted Ironforge [[reputation]]) can buy [[ram]]s to ride.

Only dwarves and people with Exalted reputation with [[Ironforge]] can learn riding skill here.
